pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-30: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: The efficacy of NEREUS for the prevention of vomiting induced by motion was evaluated in two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies: Study 1 (NCT04327661) and Study 2 (NCT05903924).
